sh: golden-haired goddess, falcon cloak, cat-drawn chariot
f: Her chariot is pulled by cats. Top that.

sh: stitched-together heap of wrong limbs, eyes and teeth
f: Nobody ordered this. It came anyway.

sh: scowling ruler in spiked black armour on a too-big throne
f: Makes the rules. Changes them when losing.

sh: black-red flames raining with smoking yellow rocks
f: Smells like eggs. Burns like Mondays.

sh: thick straight bar of blue-white energy with a bright core
f: Charging... charging... FWOOOM.

sh: swirl of soft pink petals on a breeze
f: Loves me. Loves me not. Hits me.

sh: curved rough slab of brown bark, growling
f: Worse than its bite. It has both.

sh: tumbling apple, banana, orange and grapes
f: Five a day. All five. Right now.

sh: dense rows of tall golden stalks swaying
f: Grows overnight. Ask the scarecrow.

sh: big round golden bale with straw poking out
f: There is a needle in here somewhere.

sh: wide flat sea of waving grass under a big sky
f: Miles of nothing. Then a bison.

sh: soft orange glow with a steaming mug and a blanket
f: Like a hug from a radiator.

sh: bright blue sky dome with a grinning yellow sun
f: Rise and shine. No, really. Shine.

sh: pink-orange glow with an alarm clock and a rooster
f: Five more minutes. Denied.

sh: purple-orange sky with first stars and a porch light
f: Streetlights are on. Time to come in.

sh: endless blue with fluffy clouds, pulling things upward
f: The limit. Come and touch it.

sh: half scorching sun, half blizzard swirling together
f: Hot. Cold. Hot. Make up your mind.

sh: wheel of four quarters: blossom, sun, red leaf, snowflake
f: All four at once. Pack a coat and shorts.

sh: figure windmilling arms over a sudden hole, banana peel
f: Gravity called. You answered. Loudly.

sh: whole blue-green globe with clouds, rolling like a boulder
f: You wanted the world. Here it comes. All of it.

sh: chunk of grassy dirt heaving up like a rug pulled
f: It was under you a second ago.

sh: floating island chunk with a tree, a hill and a flag
f: Land ho! It is ho-ing right at you.

sh: flying tumble of logs and planks, bark and rings showing
f: Knock on it. It knocks back.

sh: black lumpy rock with an ember-orange glow inside
f: Somebody was on the naughty list.

sh: chunky rock studded with green and purple crystals
f: They are minerals. Not rocks. Minerals.

sh: grey boulder with glittering gold veins
f: Mine it. Smelt it. Regret the inventory space.

sh: pink spiral conch with a pearly opening
f: Hold it to your ear. Hear your doom. And the sea.

sh: slow amber goo dripping with a stuck fly inside
f: Sticky for the next million years.

sh: golden droplet in a flower cup, bees incoming
f: Free samples. Bees included.

sh: tight green bud about to burst open pink
f: Small now. Give it a second.

sh: sunlit grassy circle ringed by trees, butterflies
f: Suspiciously peaceful. Boss fight peaceful.

sh: winding dirt track with signposts pointing everywhere
f: Stay on it. It does not stay on you.

sh: round dark hole in the ground with crumbling edges
f: Hellooo? ...ellooo? ...llooo?

sh: dark burrow mouth under roots with glowing eyes
f: Somebody is home. Somebody is grumpy.

sh: sandy cone with a hole on top, ants pouring out
f: Sat on by someone exactly once.

sh: streak of starlight stretching to a vanishing point
f: A distance, not a time. Common mistake.

sh: red-blue nucleus with three electrons whizzing on rings
f: Never trust it. It makes up everything.

sh: ball-and-stick model: one red ball, two white, wobbling
f: H2-Oh no.

sh: tiny glowing red ball with a plus sign
f: Stay positive.

sh: tiny grey ball with a blank face, no charge
f: For you? No charge.

sh: tiny blue spark with a minus sign zipping in loops
f: So negative. So fast.

sh: shimmering cloud of tiny glowing dots blinking in and out
f: Here. Not here. Here. Physics is weird.

sh: falling periodic table tiles: Fe, Au, Na, each glowing
f: All 118. Collect them. Dodge them.

sh: round flask of fizzing green liquid with orange fumes
f: Mix two. See what happens. Step back first.

sh: swirl of arrows, an apple, a pendulum and E=mc2
f: Every action. Equal. Opposite. Ouch.

sh: wobbling cell blobs, a leaf and a frog diagram
f: The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell.

sh: rack of smoking test tubes wired to a sparking battery
f: For science! And slightly for chaos.

sh: invisible shove shown as bending blue ripple rings
f: Mass times acceleration equals bye.

sh: blurred speed lines and after-images of a rolling ball
f: Stays in motion. Especially into you.

sh: arrow stretching longer and longer with a sonic cone
f: Speed, but it did the homework.

sh: huge thermometer, red rising one end, blue frost the other
f: Too hot. Too cold. Never just right.

sh: sloshing mystery liquid in no container at all
f: Takes the shape of its container. You.

sh: perfectly plain grey block, very hard, very square
f: Does not flow. Does not care.

sh: dense purple-blue lump that bends light around it
f: What is the matter? This. This is.

sh: dark iron ball with 1000 KG stamped on it, denting the floor
f: It is not fat. It is massive. Different.

sh: black trapezoid weight marked 16 TON dropping
f: 16 tons. Falls on cue.

sh: speaker cone blasting bars that go into the red
f: TURNED UP. WHAT? I SAID TURNED UP.

sh: tiny cube that is impossibly heavy, table cracking under it
f: Small. Heavy. Like a grudge.

sh: see-through green blob with a pink nucleus, dividing
f: One becomes two. Two becomes a problem.

sh: cloud of tiny green rod-shaped wigglers with tails
f: Wash your hands. They can hear you coming.

sh: spiky green ball covered in knobbly stalks, grinning
f: Going viral. The bad kind.

sh: wriggly pale clingy worm with a sucker mouth
f: Moves in. Eats your snacks. Never leaves.

sh: sickly green cloud with a thermometer and tissues
f: Day off school. Worth it? No.

sh: twisting blue and red ladder spiral, rungs glowing
f: You have your mother's eyes. And her right hook.

sh: line of shapes: fish, lizard, ape, human, robot, glowing
f: Give it a few million years. Or one second.

sh: blue-black beam that shows the skeleton of what it hits
f: Sees right through you. Nice ribs.

sh: clanking box of gears, pistons, funnels and a steam whistle
f: Nobody knows what it makes. It makes it loudly.

sh: falling green characters, curly braces and semicolons
f: Works on my machine.

sh: falling green circuit boards, fans and loose screws
f: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

sh: flood of ones and zeros with spinning folder icons
f: We value your privacy. We also took it.

sh: glowing globe-web of links, cat pictures and loading wheels
f: Came for one thing. Left six hours later.

sh: three curved signal bars radiating from a dot
f: One bar. In the one corner. If you stand on a chair.

sh: green pulsing rings from a blinking antenna
f: Can you hear me now? Now? Now?

sh: flat coloured squares in red, green and blue
f: One dead one. Right in the middle. Forever.

sh: floating glowing orb-head with a friendly face made of dots
f: As a large summon, I cannot... just kidding. Zap.

sh: green board with gold lines, chips and one sparking gap
f: Short one. Long shock.

sh: steel bar with a spinning wheel on each end
f: Two wheels, one bar, zero brakes.

sh: wooden wedge ramp with an orange arrow up
f: Anything is a jump if you believe.

sh: lightbulb wired to a toaster, an umbrella and a fan
f: Patent pending. Explosion also pending.

sh: big clock face with only the fat short hand, creeping
f: The last hour of school lasts nine.

sh: clock face with a thin long hand sweeping
f: One minute. In mum-on-the-phone time.

sh: red second hand ticking once with a flash
f: Blink and... there, you missed it.

sh: calendar ring of twelve months spinning with party hats
f: Twelve months. Gone. Where did it go?

sh: huge dusty hourglass with cobwebs and a long white beard
f: Waited a hundred years. Dust everywhere.

sh: neon portal showing flying cars and chrome towers
f: Flying cars any day now. Any day.

sh: sepia portal with a penny-farthing and dinosaurs behind it
f: Was better. Allegedly. Had no wifi.

sh: light blue bubbly cloud with little O2 labels
f: Breathe in. Feels good. Fire agrees.

sh: floating pale balloon-bubble marked H, one spark near it
f: Lightest element. Loudest pop.

sh: black sooty puff with tiny hexagon patterns
f: Coal, pencils and diamonds. Guess which you got.

sh: glowing green rock in a cracked lead box, hazard symbol
f: Glows in the dark. So will you.

sh: brown bottle with a sticky spoon of pink syrup
f: Tastes awful. That means it works.

sh: red and white capsule rattling in a bottle
f: One a day. Chewable. Shaped like a dinosaur.

sh: small syringe with a plaster and a brave sticker
f: Sharp scratch. Free sticker.

sh: glass tube with red liquid shooting to the top
f: 38.5. No school. Victory.

sh: seething dark red scribble cloud with angry eyebrows
f: Haters gonna hate. This one floats, too.

sh: small grey cloud raining on one wilted flower
f: Good grief.

sh: red throbbing star with jagged yellow zigzags
f: It only hurts when you exist.

sh: warm glowing shield of light with clasped hands
f: Close your eyes. Fall backwards. Probably fine.

sh: spinning coin and tumbling dice with question marks
f: Heads you win. Tails you explode.

sh: cracking egg with a rattle and a tiny hand poking out
f: Welcome to the world. It is loud here.

sh: pink ripple rings spreading from a glowing third eye
f: Mind over matter. Matter is not happy about it.

sh: glowing lightbulb popping on above nothing
f: DING! Have you tried hitting it harder?

sh: wooden nose growing longer through a puff of smoke
f: The cake is fine. Everything is fine.

sh: bright red blushing face hiding behind hands
f: Shame. Ding. Shame. Ding. Shame.

sh: growling empty stomach with a fork and knife orbiting
f: Not you when you are hungry. Worse.

sh: cracked dry tongue under a tiny blazing sun, empty cup
f: One juice box. That is all it asks.

sh: cartoon dust cloud with fists, stars and boots poking out
f: Nobody remembers who started it. Everyone is in.

sh: striped-shirt silhouette tiptoeing with a swag bag
f: Does not pay. Has a great dental plan, though.

sh: small chair in a corner under a spotlight, clock ticking
f: Go to your room. And think about what you typed.

sh: glowing red target spot blinking on a cracked armour plate
f: Hit the glowing bit. It is always the glowing bit.

sh: question marks around a spinning empty thought bubble
f: Contagious. Do not make eye contact.

sh: heavy grey drizzle cloud that follows one person only
f: Loves company. Brought a guest list.

sh: pink-gold glow with a blissful closed-eye smile
f: Ahhh. Like socks from the dryer.

sh: burst of confetti, balloons and a bouncy castle outline
f: Mandatory. Starting now.

sh: rolling wave of HA HA HA letters and tear-crying faces
f: Contagious. Milk out of the nose guaranteed.

sh: speech bubble with a rubber chicken and a ba-dum-tss drum
f: Why did the chicken cross the lane? To bonk you.

sh: upturned top hat, three cups and a vanishing coin
f: Pick a cup. Wrong. Pick again. Wrong.

sh: black curtain dropping with white THE END letters
f: Roll credits.

sh: green GO light and a starting pistol puff, fresh sunrise
f: Three. Two. One. Wait, I was not ready.

sh: chequered tape snapping across with a camera flash
f: FINISH IT. Politely.

sh: sad trombone over a red FAIL stamp
f: Wah wah wahhh.

sh: green tick in a gold burst with a tiny fist pump
f: Nailed it. First try. No one saw the others.

sh: yellow triangle sign with a black exclamation mark, flashing
f: The sign did say. You read it. You still came.

sh: orange cone, hard hat and hi-vis bubble dome
f: Safety first. Fun a distant fourth.

sh: tumbling red dice over a cliff edge
f: Could go great. Could go boom. Roll.

sh: whirl of banana peels, marbles and a whoopee cushion
f: Here comes it. With a capital T.

sh: knotted tangle blob that doubles when poked
f: 99 of them. This one is new.

sh: jigsaw piece clicking into place with a sparkle
f: Have you tried duct tape? Try more duct tape.

sh: big green tick with the number 42 glowing
f: 42. It is always 42.

sh: giant purple question mark hooked like a boomerang
f: Why? But why? But why though?

sh: flowchart shield: IF, THEN, arrows, one bent
f: Because. That is the reason. Because.

sh: dotted outline of a person with nothing inside
f: Nobody did it. Nobody is very busy.

sh: huge red NO sign with a hand held up
f: No. Next question.

sh: big green YES with a thumbs up and sparkle
f: Yes. Absolutely. What was the question?

sh: shimmering pink sparkle wave with a hand mirror and a rose
f: Stunning. Literally. Two seconds of stun.

sh: cracked mirror shockwave with a warty lumpy face
f: A face only a summoner could love.

sh: soft gold halo ring over a little white heart
f: Wins in the end. Check the script.

sh: purple-black smoke with red eyes and a curly moustache twirl
f: Mwahaha. Sorry. Reflex.

sh: spinning gold star with a plus-one arrow
f: Skill issue? Not anymore.

sh: top-hatted tycoon diving into a pile of gold coins
f: Throws money at problems. It works. Annoyingly.

sh: open empty wallet with one moth flying out
f: Wallet contains: moth. One.

sh: fluttering green banknotes and a few bouncing coins
f: Make it rain. Mind the paper cuts.

sh: single shiny copper coin flipping through the air
f: A penny for your thoughts. In the forehead.

sh: grey desk buried in paper with a ticking clock at 4:59
f: Hard work pays off later. Naps pay off now.

sh: sweeping wave of mops, sponges and a to-do list
f: No screens until this is done.

sh: beach towel, parasol, suitcase and a fruity drink
f: Out of office. Out of range. Out of sunscreen.

sh: cake with candles, balloons, party hats and a banner
f: Make a wish. Blow out the enemy.

sh: flower arch, bells, flying rice and a towering cake
f: Speak now or forever hold your pieces.

sh: black umbrellas, white lilies and a slow tolling bell
f: Here lies your winning streak.

sh: decorated tree, presents, fairy lights and falling snow
f: All you want for Christmas is the win.

sh: glowing jack-o-lanterns, bats, cobwebs and a candy bucket
f: Trick. The answer is always trick.

sh: pastel basket of painted eggs, one of them ticking
f: One of these eggs is not chocolate.

sh: long table: roast turkey, pies, corn and a horn of plenty
f: Ate too much. Cannot move. Neither can they.

sh: glitter ball dropping, clock at midnight, fireworks
f: Ten! Nine! Eight! Resolutions: broken by two.

sh: star in sunglasses on a red carpet, camera flashes
f: No photos, please. Okay, one. Okay, forty.

sh: rising arrow graph with hashtags and tiny dancing figures
f: Everyone is doing it. Nobody knows why.

sh: square pictures with bold white top and bottom text
f: Top text. Bottom text.

sh: kids in sheet-ghost and pumpkin costumes with candy bags
f: Smell my feet. Give me something good to eat.

sh: marching band, giant balloons and a float throwing sweets
f: Everybody loves one. Nobody can cross the street.

sh: striped tents, bunting, a coconut shy and a helter-skelter
f: Every game is rigged. Win the goldfish anyway.

sh: big stage, flags, muddy field and a thousand tiny tents
f: Lost your tent. Lost your friends. Best weekend.

sh: floating set of snapping teeth, bite-mark arc
f: Nom.

sh: quick straight glove punch with a tiny impact star
f: Quick. Rude. Repeatable.

sh: single fast thrust line ending in a sharp point glint
f: Stick them with the pointy end.

sh: thin silver slash line that parts things in two
f: Measure twice. Cut everything.

sh: green code window reading ACCESS GRANTED, glitch sparks
f: I am in. Password was "password".

sh: shadow on exaggerated tiptoes with a finger to its lips
f: Tip. Toe. Tip. Toe. Creak. Freeze.

sh: pair of eyes peering from a walking bush
f: That bush was not there before.

sh: drawn bow and paw-print trail leading to the target
f: Shh. Follow the paw prints.

sh: big leather mitt snapping shut around a ball
f: Got it! Got it! Do not got it.

sh: masked figure dashing off with a bulging swag sack
f: Yoink. Legally distinct from borrowing.

sh: jagged black crack racing across the ground
f: Step on one. See what happens to mum's back.

sh: whirling metal teeth spitting out paper ribbons
f: Homework goes in. Confetti comes out.

sh: rapid-fire beak jabs like a tiny jackhammer
f: Peckpeckpeckpeckpeckpeck.

sh: sharp yellow-black dart with a red throbbing ring
f: Tiny jab. Huge fuss.

sh: flying lipstick print trailed by tiny hearts
f: Eww! Cooties! Critical cooties!

sh: big pink tongue swipe leaving a shiny drool trail
f: Licked it. It is mine now. Those are the rules.

sh: classic brown swirl with stink lines, two flies, big smile
f: Everybody does it. Nobody steps in it twice.

sh: small yellow puddle with a wavy shine and a tiny sign
f: Should have gone before we left.

sh: chunky green-orange cartoon splash arc with carrot bits
f: There are always carrots. Nobody ate carrots.

sh: sound rings shaped like cat ears with a tiny paw print
f: Feed me. Feed me. It is 4 a.m. Feed me.

sh: wobbly lip under two fountain jets of tears
f: But I don't WANNA lose.

sh: wagging finger with a speech bubble of blah blah blah
f: Are we there yet? Are we there yet? Are we

sh: flaming speech bubble with symbols and a mic drop
f: Oooooh. Somebody get the ice.

sh: sudden huge white screaming face lunging forward
f: BOO. Sorry. Did you drop your keyboard?

sh: ringing alarm clock shockwave with a bucket of water
f: RISE AND SHINE. It is 6 a.m. on a Saturday.

sh: pair of jaws grinding side to side, crumbs flying
f: Thirty-two times before swallowing. Granny rules.

sh: tall fizzy cup with ice, straw and a tiny umbrella
f: Chug! Chug! Chug! Brain freeze.

sh: noodle being sucked up at speed, broth droplets
f: Rude at dinner. Devastating in battle.

sh: open oven door glowing gold, tray of rising buns
f: 180 degrees. Twenty minutes. Golden brown.

sh: bubbling golden oil spitting hot droplets
f: Everything is better deep fried. Except you.

sh: wooden spoon whirling everything into a swirl
f: Stirring the pot. Literally and socially.

sh: tipped glass and a spreading puddle heading for the laptop
f: No use crying over it. Slip on it instead.

sh: spray bottle firing one sharp jet of water
f: Bad summon! Off the couch!

sh: sparkling wipe arc leaving a gleaming streak and bubbles
f: Squeaky clean. Hear that? That is the squeak.

sh: steel bar curling into a pretzel shape
f: Bent it with your mind. Or your hands.

sh: enemy outline creased in half like a paper sheet
f: Fold. Fold again. Now you are a swan.

sh: fat rope pretzel knot pulled tight, frayed ends
f: Left over right. Right over... no. Start again.

sh: golden key turning in a floating keyhole, light bursting out
f: Click. New area discovered.
